headline: Colombia's Democratic Center Proposes Mandatory Business Bonds to Fund State
summary: Colombia's Centro Democrático proposed a mechanism where companies would lend 20% of their profits to the state in exchange for reduced taxes, avoiding traditional tax hikes.
why: Fiscal policy proposals involving corporate lending and tax restructuring directly impact corporate earnings and investment sentiment in Colombia.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Corporate liquidity and tax burdens would be altered by mandatory profit-lending schemes.
